typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		FO_TRADE_ID as string,
		SOURCE_SYSTEM as string,
		NPV_VALUE as string,
		NPV_DATE as string,
		NPV_CURRENCY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		COLLATERALIZATION_TYPE as string,
		HOLD_ID as string,
		{Week Ending Date} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		weekEndingDate as timestamp,
		foTradeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource derive(loaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE} = PRODUCT_TYPE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of Week Ending Date} == weekEndingDate && FO_TRADE_ID == foTradeId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		npvCurrency as string,
		collateralizationType as string,
		foTradeId as string,
		sourceSystem as string,
		weekEndingDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		npvDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		holdId as string,
		npvValue as double,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		productType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		npvCurrency = NPV_CURRENCY,
		collateralizationType = COLLATERALIZATION_TYPE,
		foTradeId = FO_TRADE_ID,
		sourceSystem = SOURCE_SYSTEM,
		weekEndingDate = {Copy of Week Ending Date},
		npvDate = NPV_DATE,
		holdId = HOLD_ID,
		npvValue = NPV_VALUE,
		loadDate = loaddate,
		productType = {Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
